characters.name: 丰川祥子
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game character sprite atlas for a 2D anime fighting game, including one UI bust.
Primary request: Create a completely new, polished, consistent anime game asset sheet of Sakiko Togawa (豊川祥子, Oblivionis) from BanG Dream! Ave Mujica, using the attached official image ONLY as a character identity and stage-costume reference. Do not copy the reference pose or its dark drop shadow.
Subject: same youthful anime girl in every cell, long pale periwinkle blue hair in low twin tails with black ribbons, straight bangs, golden eyes; deep burgundy high-neck short puff-sleeved top, black ruffled neck ribbon and oval blue jewel, fitted black waist corset with brown front lacing and brown waist belt, tiered asymmetric black/charcoal/cream ruffle skirt with fine gold decoration, dark tights and lace-up dark boots. Keep her costume exactly recognizable from reference. Her face is visible without a mask.
Style: premium hand-drawn 2D anime game illustration, clean dark outlines, crisp cel shading with restrained painted highlights, refined expressive face, naturally proportioned approx six-head-tall body, consistent detail and scale across all full-body frames.
Composition: an EXACT 4-column by 2-row atlas on a 2048 x 1536 transparent canvas, EIGHT identical rectangular cells. Every figure stays ENTIRELY inside its own cell with generous transparent space between cells. No overlapping cells. Full-body figures include hair tips, both hands and both feet. Common head height and common foot baseline within each row. ALL seven full-body poses face to the RIGHT in a readable 3/4 side view.
Top row, left to right: 1 calm ready idle stance; 2 walking with left foot forward; 3 walking with right foot forward; 4 airborne jumping with knees bent, flowing skirt.
Bottom row, left to right: 5 strong forward attacking arm gesture to the RIGHT; 6 dramatic keyboard-magic casting gesture with one hand lifted, no rendered particles; 7 recoiling from a hit, leaning back, still standing, face visible; 8 large frontal head-and-shoulders portrait, centered, calm serious face, with entire hair silhouette and upper chest, for HUD avatar and ultimate cut-in.
Lighting: neutral clean soft studio lighting, no floor.
Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background. No backdrop, checkerboard, white matte, frame, panel outlines, grid lines, labels, lettering, logos, watermarks, floating decorative elements, rendered shadows or particles. No extra characters. Precisely eight well separated cells. Reference is identity and clothing guidance; output is fresh game art.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production transparent 4-column by 2-row anime game sprite atlas.
Edit target: attached eight-cell character atlas of Sakiko / 祥子.

Required change: a solid black portable electronic KEYBOARD with clearly visible alternating white and black piano keys, compact enough to carry across her waist on a black shoulder strap. In casting cell 6 one hand supports it and the other strikes its keys. The keyboard is visible in all seven full-body cells; it must not float.
Keep the same eight-cell layout and image aspect ratio, same identity, facial features, hairstyle, stage costume, body proportions, palette, cel-shaded art style and quality. Reposition arms/hands only as needed to convincingly grip and attack with the instrument. Preserve the upper-right jumping pose and bottom-right portrait composition; the portrait remains a clean instrument-free head-and-shoulders UI image.
Frame order is unchanged: top row idle, walk A, walk B, jump; bottom row instrument attack, instrument skill, hurt, frontal portrait.
Every whole figure and the whole instrument stays INSIDE its original cell, with generous transparent gaps. No overlapping neighbouring cells. Keep feet within each cell and standing foot baselines consistent. Seven full bodies face RIGHT. All hands must visibly hold the correct instrument; absolutely no floating detached weapons.
Transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no checkerboard, no shadows, no particle effects, no extra characters. Do not add any unrequested costume items.
